title: Not as spacious as my usual bag but I like that it cinches tight
text:
Not as spacious as my usual bag but I like that it cinches tight. This review is for the unbleached bags. I usually purchase these [[ASIN:B0773DJ8Q3 300 PCS Disposable Tea Filter Bags]] but decided to try these unbleached ones. The first picture shows how small and thin these are compared to my white ones.

My major like is that the string cinches the bag very tight and it stays closed unlike my white filter bag. However, since this is small, it is harder to insert one teaspoon of tea into the opening. It is amazing that the filter does not disintegrate in hot water. Also, I am shocked by how thin these are. A 300 pack of these filters take up one third the space of my white filters. I almost thought they did not send me what I ordered. However, the thinness is a plus for me for storage.

Overall, I like these. I do not know yet whether I will order these again over the white ones as there are pros and cons to both. For instance, the white filters I order never stay shut. I will decide when I need to place another order.

UPDATE October 23, 2019 - I have decided to lower my rating of these bags from 4 to 3 stars after using them for several months. These are smaller than the [[ASIN:B0773DJ8Q3 300 PCS Disposable Tea Filter Bags]] I am use to and they are easier to rip unless handled gently. I will only order these in a pinch and prefer the other bags instead.
